title: THE GREAT ESCAPE BREACH 1 - ODABLOCK WARRIORS (OSRS)
summary: Voice-comms footage from the first breach of Deadman Mode Season 3, where Gnomonkey's team, the Odablock Warriors, clear out the Dino Nuggets and are then chased into a retreat by Westham Weasels. The team coordinates a distraction, regroups at Falador and tries to stall the pursuing clans.

outline.text: Gnomonkey escapes the pursuit but is frozen by Westham after he teleports in
Planning counter-play around a three-minute skull and sharing blood runes
Executing the distraction: teammates keep committing while Gnomonkey waits out his skull
Regrouping at Falador and scouting the centre
Stalling for survival: Gnomonkey is out of teleport charges while teammates plan to sneak back in
Final regroup at Falador, borrowing a spade, candle and tinderbox, and planning to repeat the entry

claims.text: During the first breach of Deadman Mode Season 3, Gnomonkey escapes a chase but is frozen by a Westham Weasels player who teleported in on him.
Gnomonkey notes that with three minutes left on his skull he could go back with his tier five sacks and become a little stronger again, and asks a teammate for their blood runes to use.
A teammate suggests the team should not give up the pursuit and should keep committing to random targets, so the chasing clans cannot concentrate on one player.
Gnomonkey is told to wait out his skull before teleporting, and the team tells a teammate to waste the pursuer's time by running while the skull expires.
A teammate says Validor teleports are free, and suggests players use them to teleport back in.
Gnomonkey runs out of teleport charges and cannot teleport or log off while being chased, so he stalls the enemy while the rest of the team moves.
After an escape the team can use a home teleport once the pursuing players give up, logging back in and teleporting after the one-minute window.
The Odablock Warriors, Gnomonkey's Deadman Mode Season 3 team, clear out the Dino Nuggets during the first breach and are then chased into a retreat.
The Odablock Warriors assume the Dino Nuggets are stalling like the Westham Weasels and Rhinos, so they discuss how to play the stand-off.
The Odablock Warriors tell all remaining team members to meet at Falador after the chase, with Gnomonkey waiting on his skull before joining.
The Odablock Warriors see one of the Rhinos die and conclude the Rhinos were probably pushed by the Dino Nuggets, so they plan to sneak in again.
At Falador the Odablock Warriors share a spade, a lit candle and a tinderbox so every teammate can re-enter, and say they are doing well for the cards they have been dealt.
A Westham Weasels player teleports in on Gnomonkey and freezes him as he tries to escape during the first Deadman Season 3 breach.
The Odablock Warriors treat the Westham Weasels and the Rhinos as two clans pursuing them while the Dino Nuggets stall.
The Odablock Warriors expect the Rhinos to have won the first breach and to be camping the rope after the team is flushed out.
Gnomonkey uses a Chronicle teleport to get out of the chase in the first Deadman breach and calls Camelot teleport 'safe'.
When the Chronicle runs out of charges Gnomonkey cannot teleport away, which leaves him stuck while the enemy closes in.
